entities.summary: Angelo Filippetti was an Italian politician and doctor who served as the Mayor of Milan from 1920 to 1922. A member of the Italian Socialist Party (PSI), Filippetti was dismissed by the Royal Prefect Alfredo Lusignoli on 3 August 1922 after members of the Blackshirts occupied Milan's city hall, the Palazzo Marino. Lusignoli appointed a prefectural commissioner, Count Ferdinando Lalli, as Filippetti's replacement.
